notes: Background: real-time personalization for homepage & checkout. High qps spikes around campaigns (peak ~1.2k qps), usually 200-400 qps baseline.
Primary requirement: sub-30ms p50 response for single-turn personalize calls; p99 target <150ms (including network). Cost sensitive — want $/1000-token equivalent metrics vs current setup.

Model preferences: open model variants OK, but want deterministic routing to smaller quantized variants for tail requests. Interested in INT8/FP16 paths and how Redwood recommends quantization profiles.

Optimization interest: batching where possible for throughput windows, prefix/KV caching for repeated user contexts, and auto-batching policy that preserves p99 SLO. Ask: how does Redwood do continuous batching without increasing cold-start latency?

Security/compliance: must integrate with company SSO (SAML), KMS for keying, and full audit logs for model access. Data residency preference: US only for PII pathways.
